findings.summary: I2C bus AT25_MOSI/AT25_SCK: SCL missing pull-up
findings.description: I2C bus with 1 device(s) (U5) has no pull-up on SCL net AT25_SCK.

fix_params.basis: I2C spec requires pull-ups on SCL

findings.summary: Regulator U4: PG status unknown for TPS62840YBGR (no datasheet extraction)
findings.description: Regulator U4 (TPS62840YBGR) supplies +1V8 to U302, U302, U302 but PG status is unknown. Run sync_datasheets to verify.
findings.recommendation: Run sync_datasheets to verify whether TPS62840YBGR has a PG pin.

report_context.impact: Downstream devices may latch up or boot incorrectly

findings.summary: U2 pin CRST (__unnamed_3) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin CRST on U2 (BMM350) is connected to net __unnamed_3 but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from __unnamed_3 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin CRST is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up
